Parent plan: https://chatgpt.com/space/page_0d26b92b5bc8819181fab088efc0283c

## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
lib/zaq/channels/delivery_confirmation.ex plus focused existing bridge/API assertions. Clear attachments on confirmation copy, retain metadata ID allowlist and transport receipt. Audit caller retry/duplicate behavior and document existing semantics without adding deduplication.

## Tests to add before implementation
Reuse zaq-9th tests rather than duplicating rescue/exit coverage. Add confirmation Event exclusion of Records/handles/bytes/paths, message IDs retained, confirmed delivery survives recording error/exception, status/callback failures cause no resend, acceptance then timeout has no false confirmed receipt.

## Branches/paths validated
Preparation failure sends nothing; upload/post failure; confirmed delivery then bookkeeping failure; uncertain interruption. Repeated caller submission documented, not conflated with intentional resend. Temp cleanup only owns prepared resources.

## Mocking plan
Supported per-call router option for Engine recording edge and adapter boundary failures; no global mutable state.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
Keep affected module docs accurate. Coordinate the final docs/services/channels.md update and update this issue with evidence/decisions; follow documentation hygiene.

## Action reuse assessment
Extend existing DeliveryConfirmation projection; reuse receipt and error contract. No new receipt module, retry system or lifecycle state machine.

## Constraints and validation
Read parent settled decisions and applicable repository service, tool-routing, Action reuse and testing policies before implementation. Preserve current test behavior. Follow authoritative validation lifecycle; feature E2E authoring waits for final review task, but focused tests are immediate. Agent selection and #875 acquisition budgets are outside scope. No global configuration mutation.

comments.text: Module-context / live Action reuse before implementation: DeliveryConfirmation is Channels-to-Engine orchestration/projection only, public record/3 entry. Api.deliver_outgoing invokes one bridge send, normalizes result then record; confirmed results build fixed Engine record_delivery_confirmation Event, preserve receipt and allowlisted canonical metadata IDs; error/unconfirmed passthrough. Engine.Api delegates History.Delivery.capture: optional history association, no provider operation. HistoryIngress.record_confirmation_transaction serializes identity, fingerprints content/receipt scope and reuses matching canonical message; HistoryDeliveryWorker max_attempts10/unique job retries ID-only association and never sends. Source bytes remain source-owned, prepared in-memory buffers remain scoped to bridge consumer; confirmation event should retain no attachment Records/handles/bytes/paths. Module state: no persistent state; source provider owns accepted upload/post, Engine owns confirmation/history rows and association jobs. Risk: confirmed send followed by recording outage must remain confirmed to avoid encouragement of duplicate sends. Existing zaq-9th exception/exit tests already cover unchanged fallback branches and are reused verbatim, unrelated issue stays open. Existing .3 tests already prove real adapter upload/post failures, bare/Req timeout no false confirmation, status/callback errors/exits no second upload/send, missing provider ID uncertainty. Existing .4 tests prove no send after preparation failure and SMTP error no confirmed receipt. No duplicate scenarios planned. New tests before production: property strips arbitrary Record attachment collection while preserving original Outgoing, receipt/routing/body and existing ID allowlist; unconfirmed/error result never dispatches Engine; real default Mattermost HTTP + API recording-error integration demonstrates one upload/post per caller submission and no automatic resend, repeating the same Event intentionally results in another send. Action discovery from .2/.3 unchanged: reuse Materialization/provider clients and existing record/3/history capture operation, extend local projection only. No new Action, receipt module, lifecycle/retry/dedup state or tool exposure. Preliminary retry audit: bridge/API/NodeRouter execute one send per delivery request, Agent schedules a single Channels return hop; notification dispatcher falls back to next configured channel only on error (current notification Outgoing has empty attachments); inbound Jido dedupe is distinct from outgoing transport; Engine association idempotency is not outbound dedupe. Existing transport retries will remain untouched and audited separately. Applicable policy files unchanged since .3/.4; Serena activation succeeded but overview stalled >30s, cancelled and bounded fallback used.

Final validation: mix q passed (formatting, compile, hooks.verify8, Credo1674 no issues, docs), git diff --check clean. Focused green: 25 passed (2 properties,23 tests). Final exact command: mix test test/zaq/channels/delivery_confirmation_test.exs test/zaq/channels/api_test.exs test/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge_test.exs test/zaq/channels/jido_chat_delivery_test.exs test/zaq/channels/telegram_history_delivery_test.exs test/zaq/channels/telegram_markdown_delivery_test.exs test/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge/delivery_result_test.exs test/zaq/channels/email_bridge_test.exs test/zaq/channels/email_bridge/outgoing_attachments_test.exs test/zaq/channels/email_bridge/smtp_sender_test.exs test/zaq/channels/delivery_files_test.exs test/zaq/engine/messages/outgoing_test.exs. Result exit0,488 passed (8 properties,480 tests),49.4s. Logs /tmp/zaq-juu-5-final-tests.log and /tmp/zaq-juu-5-q.log. Non-failing observation: background NodeRouter async task in Channels.Api.send_typing/ChannelConfig queried after Sandbox owner exit; stack had no attachment/confirmation frame. Base not reproduced, so no claim of proven pre-existing root cause. No unrelated changes. Final production only attachments:[] on confirmation copy plus accurate module/function docs. Existing zaq-9th tests unchanged; original attachment Records remain caller-owned and immutable. Parent reviewed tests/diff with no finding. Retry audit completed: Channels.Api sends once then records; NodeRouter sync executes once per hop; Agent schedules single final Channels hop; explicit repeated submission sends again (real HTTP/API test proves two independent submissions each one upload/post despite recording failure). No transport exactly-once guarantee. HistoryIngress locks/fingerprint and HistoryDeliveryWorker max_attempts10/unique reference job apply only to history association, never resend. Existing Notifications falls back to another configured channel on error including ambiguous error; current notification messages have no attachments, unchanged. Req default safe_transient retries GET/HEAD; current Mattermost upload/post do not opt POST into retry. SMTP library gen_smtp retains session/host retry behavior (default retries1); SmtpSender adds no retry option. Provider owns accepted uploads/posts; an upload may remain when post fails, and timeout cannot prove nonacceptance; no compensating provider deletion or new retry/dedup state added. Prepared bytes remain in-memory, no owned temp files or original source deletion; acquisition remains whole-content #875. Safe statuses remain .3 examples; recording outage returns confirmed receipt with confirmation_recording:unavailable; uncertain send never records confirmation. Final feature presentation/UX approval .6, E2E authoring, numerical coverage and final precommit stay pending later gates. Ready for commit/integration/push before close/sync.
